entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Battle Mending

One adjacent living ally; free hand (the hart’s antlers provide this). Pay 3 HP first, bypass resistance, and remain above 0. A player rolls this creature’s Reason: Weak heals 5, Standard 10, Strong 15 HP. Life resistance reduces healing, minimum 1. This spell provokes. entries.effect: Ally within 3: reduce Frightened 1; +1 Boon on its next mental defense.
entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Warding Light

*A warm light settles over one companion like a hand on the shoulder.*

One willing ally within 3 squares reduces Frightened by 1. Until this creature’s next turn, that ally also has 1 Boon on its next defense against a mental attack; for an NPC ally, impose 1 Bane on that player attack. Consumed even if canceled; does not stack with itself.

*Light gathers over a companion like overlapping feathers, taking the harsh edge from the impact.*

Before one visible willing ally within 3 squares takes damage from an attack, grant that ally Physical resistance 2 for that attack only. Use the highest matching resistance, not an added reduction; minimum damage rules remain. This does not heal, transfer damage or grant resistance to other types.

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 1; an explicit creature trait, not a bonus from size.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Silver hoof prints fade when the sun reaches them.

**Purpose:** Lead the lost out of places that mean to keep them.

**Tactics and retreat:** Heal a companion, then push pursuers aside; never stay to punish a defeated foe.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Show that someone needs rescue rather than trying to capture it.

**Habitat:** Moonlit forest · **Communication:** Understands Common and Fey; communicates through simple images

**Loot:** A safe route or a returned lost possession.

**Summoning:** Fey 7 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/summons/moon-hart.md).
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-moon-hart


**Category:** Fey · **Role:** Rescuer · **CV:** 28

**Difficulty rationale:** An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Ordinary attack difficulty; riders and positioning carry the threat.

**Reference damage:** 4/5/7

**Reference type:** radiant

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.65

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.5 → 1.65: Maneuver allowance +0.05, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=4.404, O=5.162. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [battle mending](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/battle-mending.md), [driving blow](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/driving-blow.md), [Sheltering Light](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/sheltering-light.md), [Warding Light](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/warding-light.md).

# Battle Mending

*Light travels from the healer’s shaking hands into another body, leaving the healer visibly diminished.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-battle-mending


**Action:** Main Action; spell

One visible adjacent living creature; free hand required. Pay the printed life cost first, bypassing resistance, and remain above 0 HP. A player controller rolls the creature’s printed healing attribute for its printed HP outcomes. For a hostile NPC healing an ally, ask a player to make that same creature-attribute roll, including its applicable Boons/Banes. The DA still chooses its action and target; being the dice roller grants no control of the NPC. Life resistance reduces healing normally. This may instead target a healing-harmed creature: the result becomes Life damage, with Fortitude defense if a player is defending for that creature and no extra opposed roll. Keep the same range, life cost and free-hand requirement. This can be repeated while affordable. Provokes as spellcasting; no separate spell slots.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.
